basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old male hailing from the Pacific Northwest. After years of working in IT as a network administrator, I realized the importance of balancing sedentary work with a healthy lifestyle. I enjoy hiking and exploring the natural beauty around my area. My interests include nutrition, fitness, and exploring new dietary philosophies, which led me to the Warrior Diet. I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM PST, when I can unwind and catch up on my favorite subreddits. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it allows me to focus on personal growth and health.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in IT due to my professional background and a personal interest in nutrition and fitness. Over the years, I've read extensively about different dietary approaches and experimented with several, including intermittent fasting and OMAD. Most of my knowledge in these areas is self-taught through books, podcasts, and participating in online communities.
